mappedContracts.statement: Bind credentials and cookies to verified HTTPS origins, paths, and redirect destinations.
acceptanceCriteria: Cookie headers are computed per request from a scoped cookie jar.
Substack cookies are never forwarded to arbitrary publication or redirect hosts.
Redirects are handled manually and re-authorized.
Custom domains and canonical Substack API origins are modelled separately.

mappedContracts.statement: Prohibit guessed POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE endpoint discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown mutations remain planning-only or manual.
Every executable mutation references exact first-party capture evidence, method, request schema, response schema, and last verified version.
Domain, team, refund, moderation, subscriber, publication-setting, revise, and unschedule surfaces are audited.

mappedContracts.statement: Separate official Substack API, undocumented internal creator API, browser automation, and simulator adapters with explicit support and stability labels.
acceptanceCriteria: No undifferentiated 'Substack API' abstraction hides provenance.
Every endpoint records official/internal/browser status, auth, evidence, last verification, and safety state.
